The working method is Spray method: start air off the piece, move across, trigger paint, release paint before stopping air Practice means rehearsing the idea until it can be reconstructed from scratch, which is exactly what the accompanying study program drills.
requirements: Reader needs no prior background: every term used here is defined in this entry or in the Foundations tier entries before it.
standards: Standard curricula, textbooks, and professional references for airbrush basics.
provenance: Signature-authored fundamentals written for the JAH Signature system; speculative or interpretive content is Signature-labeled.
